# Tests

Math 2C03 is participating in McMaster's Flexible Testing pilot. Test 1 will
be an in-person, invigilated online childsmath test. Students will choose an
available writing time within the testing period and bring a device that can
connect to childsmath. The assigned Test 1 sessions and room are listed below.
Sign-up details and any changes to the schedule will be announced.

Read McMaster's [Flexible Testing: Student Sign-Up & Testing
Guide](Flexible_Testing_Student_Sign-Up_and_Testing_Guide.pdf) for instructions
on choosing or changing a testing time, preparing your device, checking in,
submitting your test, and using approved accommodations.

The plan is to use the Flexible Testing scheme for Test 2 as well, unless
significant administrative problems with Test 1 make that impractical. Any
change to the Test 2 format will be announced well in advance.

Unless the instructor announces otherwise, each test covers course material
up to and including the class immediately before its testing period begins.

Each test is designed as a one-hour assessment, with a two-hour writing block
available to all students. Calculators are not permitted. Students may not
bring a formula sheet. If a formula sheet or other resources are appropriate
for a test, they will be provided with the test by the instructor.

| Test | Testing period | Status | Planned format |
|---:|:---|:---|:---|
| 1 | Wednesday, 7 October to Saturday, 10 October 2026 | Assigned sessions; sign-up details to follow | Flexible Testing pilot |
| 2 | Monday, 30 November 2026 to Thursday, 3 December 2026 | Tentative testing period | Flexible Testing pilot (planned) |
